script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A cozy, well-lit living room in a modern loft apartment. SARAH, late 20s, dressed in business attire, sits on a plush couch, staring intently at her laptop.

SARAH
(whispering to herself)
Come on, come on... I can do this.

She takes a deep breath, her hands trembling as she clicks on a job application. A series of pop-up windows appear, each one asking for more personal information.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

Sarah enters the kitchen, where her boyfriend, MARK, early 30s, a successful chef, is preparing breakfast.

MARK
(looking up)
Morning, love. What's wrong?

SARAH
I can't do it anymore, Mark. I can't keep going down this path.

MARK
(placing a plate in front of her)
What path?

SARAH
(sighs)
My career. I can't keep living this lie.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Sarah sits alone at a table, her laptop open in front of her. She types furiously, her eyes focused on the screen. Across the room, JASON, mid-30s, a passionate painter, observes her from a distance.

JASON
(to himself)
She looks so sad.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Jason enters an art gallery, his eyes drawn to a beautiful painting of a woman. He is mesmerized by it, and as he approaches, he notices Sarah standing nearby.

JASON
(approaching)
This is a beautiful piece. Who painted it?

SARAH
(surprised)
Thank you. I did.

JASON
(smiling)
I'm Jason. I couldn't help but notice you in the coffee shop earlier.

SARAH
(wary)
I'm Sarah.

They exchange pleasantries, and Jason learns that Sarah has been working in a corporate job she doesn't enjoy.

JASON
You deserve to be happy. Why not pursue your passion?

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Mark listens intently as Sarah explains her decision to quit her job and pursue her art.

MARK
(concerned)
But what about the money? How will we survive?

SARAH
(determined)
I'll find a way. I have to try.

INT. ART CLASSROOM - DAY

Sarah attends her first art class, feeling both nervous and excited. She meets other aspiring artists, including RICHARD, a charismatic and supportive instructor.

RICHARD
(smiling)
Welcome, Sarah. I've heard great things about you.

SARAH
(smiling back)
Thank you, Richard. I'm nervous, but I'm ready to learn.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Sarah meet again at the coffee shop. They discuss their art and their shared desire to pursue their passions.

JASON
I've never met anyone as brave as you, Sarah.

SARAH
(smiling)
And I've never met anyone as inspiring as you, Jason.

They share a meaningful look, and it's clear that a connection has been made.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

Sarah works late into the night in her studio apartment, painting with passion and determination. She looks up at her finished work, feeling a sense of pride and fulfillment.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Sarah's artwork is displayed in a prestigious art gallery. A crowd gathers around her painting, admiring her talent and creativity.

MARK
(arriving)
I'm so proud of you, Sarah.

SARAH
(hugging him)
Thank you, Mark. I couldn't have done it without you.

JASON
(joining them)
Congratulations, Sarah. Your art is truly beautiful.

SARAH
(smiling at Jason)
Thank you, Jason. You've been a huge inspiration to me.

They share a moment of appreciation, knowing that they have all found happiness and fulfillment through their passions.

FADE OUT.
